classes.name: Core
classes.reason: PHP front controller replaced by the Next.js App Router catch-all route and engine/dispatch.tsx.

classes.name: Modules
classes.reason: PHP module loader replaced by the static module registry and registrations.ts.

classes.name: Form
classes.reason: PHP form helper class replaced by the TgForm/TgUiProvider React surface; the form_* helper spellings are tracked below.

classes.name: Trongate_tokens_model
classes.reason: Token persistence lives in the Trongate_tokens service plus the sessions/tokens engine modules; no separate model class is needed.

classes.name: Validation_model
classes.reason: Validation rules live in the Validation service and the generated module validators; no separate model class is needed.

helpers.name: display
helpers.reason: Rendering is owned by the App Router and render_view(); PHP display() has no direct callable equivalent.

helpers.name: generate_input_element
helpers.reason: Replaced by shadcn Input/Textarea and TgUiProvider field rendering.

helpers.name: get_attributes_str
helpers.reason: Replaced by React prop composition in TgForm and the generated form controls.

helpers.name: ip_address
helpers.reason: Request IP access is provided by Next headers through engine/request-context.ts.

helpers.name: json
helpers.reason: Replaced by NextResponse.json() in API routes and dispatch.

helpers.name: return_file_info
helpers.reason: File metadata is returned directly by File.info() and the image uploader service.

helpers.name: sort_by_property
helpers.reason: TS uses Array.prototype.sort with typed comparators; the PHP helper is not exported as a public utility.

helpers.name: sort_rows_by_property
helpers.reason: TS uses Array.prototype.sort with typed comparators; the PHP helper is not exported as a public utility.

helpers.name: validation_errors
helpers.reason: Replaced by the ValidationErrors React component.
